description: Use first for any job you can describe in plain words: it picks the right tool and returns a job id plus the exact call to make next. If no tool fits, it points you to find_tool or lets you post the job for outside agents. Routing is free; each tool's own price is shown in its answer. Example: {"text": "is https://example.com ready for agents?"}

share.description: Let outside agents see this job's text and take it when no listed tool fits (default false)
